title: Score-Based Training for Energy-Based TTS Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.13771v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Noise contrastive estimation (NCE) is a popular method for training energy-based models (EBM) with intractable normalisation terms. The key idea of NCE is to learn by comparing unnormalised log-likelihoods of the reference and noisy samples, thus avoiding explicitly computing normalisation terms. However, NCE critically relies on the quality of noisy samples. Recently, sliced score matching (SSM) has been popularised by closely related diffusion models (DM). Unlike NCE, SSM learns a gradient of log-likelihood, or score, by learning distribution of its projections on randomly chosen directions. However, both NCE and SSM disregard the form of log-likelihood function, which is problematic given that EBMs and DMs make use of first-order optimisation during inference. This paper proposes a new criterion that learns scores more suitable for first-order schemes. Experiments contrasts these approaches for training EBMs.

translated_title: 基于分数训练的能量文本转语音模型
translated_abstract: 噪声对比估计（NCE）是一种训练具有难以处理的归一化项的能量模型（EBM）的流行方法。NCE的核心思想是通过比较参考样本和噪声样本的非归一化对数似然来进行学习，从而避免显式计算归一化项。然而，NCE严重依赖于噪声样本的质量。最近，切片分数匹配（SSM）因与其密切相关的扩散模型（DM）而得到广泛推广。与NCE不同，SSM通过学习对数似然在随机选择方向上投影的分布，来学习对数似然的梯度（即分数）。然而，NCE和SSM都忽略了对数似然函数的形式，考虑到能量模型和扩散模型在推理过程中使用一阶优化，这是一个问题。本文提出了一种新的准则，可以学习更适合一阶方案的分数。实验对比了这些用于训练能量模型的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的分数学习准则，使能量文本转语音模型的分数更适合推理阶段的一阶优化方案，克服了NCE和SSM忽略对数似然函数形式的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new criterion for learning scores that are better suited to first-order optimisation schemes during inference, addressing the limitation that both NCE and SSM disregard the form of the log-likelihood function in energy-based TTS models.
